atoms.name: Big-O, Omega, Theta, little-o
atoms.one_line: Upper, lower and tight bounds; o means the ratio goes to 0.

atoms.name: Growth-rate ladder
atoms.one_line: 1, log n, n, n log n, n^2, n^3, 2^n, n!, n^n in that order.

atoms.name: Comparing functions with logs
atoms.one_line: Take log of both sides; exponents decide.

atoms.name: Counting loops
atoms.one_line: Independent nested loops multiply; dependent bounds need a sum.

atoms.name: Logarithmic and harmonic loops
atoms.one_line: Doubling or halving gives log n; step i gives n/i and a harmonic sum.

atoms.name: Recurrence from recursive code
atoms.one_line: Count calls and work per call; unroll to see the pattern.

atoms.name: Master theorem
atoms.one_line: Compare f(n) with n^(log_b a): smaller, equal, or larger.

atoms.name: Beyond the master theorem
atoms.one_line: T(n-1)+n sums, sqrt(n) needs n=2^m, unequal splits use the recursion tree.

atoms.name: Space complexity
atoms.one_line: Auxiliary space is the extra memory; recursion costs its depth.

atoms.name: Cases, amortisation and lower bounds
atoms.one_line: Best, worst, average; 3n/2-2 for min and max; amortised counters.
